name: balaaca-frontend
_comment_type: ESM, so node runs the .mts tests without a flag that says so. Next is ESM-first and its own config here is TypeScript already; the alternative was a MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON warning on every test run, which is the kind of noise a green log stops meaning anything under.
description: The Next.js BFF. Every token stays on this server; the browser gets HTML.
_comment_overrides: sharp and postcss arrive transitively from next and lag its own fixes. Pinning them here fixes the tree in one place; a second Node package that forgot would be found by OSV-Scanner and not before.
